trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum award and it opens only after the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task to chase; it falls into your account automatically as the list fills up. Work the roadmap in order and leave this one unticked in your tracker until 54 of 55 are done.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Follow the roadmap to the end

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Awarded for clearing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. Follow the prologue objectives to the end and the trophy appears on the completion screen. The mission is mandatory, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing
Collect the trophy at mission complete

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Granted when the first chapter of the story is finished. Just advance the main objectives through Chapter 1; no side activity changes the outcome. Chapters play in order, so finishing the campaign guarantees it.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Earned by completing Chapter 2 of the main story. Keep following the storyline missions until the chapter ends. There is no time limit and no special condition, so it is unmissable.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Finish the chapter to unlock it

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unlocked when Chapter 3 is completed. Play through the missions in sequence and the trophy triggers at the chapter end. Because the story is linear, you cannot lock yourself out of it.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Collect the trophy at the chapter end

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 4. Advance the plot through the chapter's final objective and it pops automatically. Nothing in free roam affects it, so simply play the story.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Finish the final mission of the chapter

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Earned by finishing the story's last mission. It is a Gold trophy, so it belongs at the end of the campaign rather than the beginning. Clear any missable moments you care about before you cross the ending, because the campaign will be behind you.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Reach and complete the final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Awarded for clearing the mission called Breakfast Run. It is a straightforward story mission, so follow the markers and see it through. There are no hidden conditions attached to it.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unlocked after finishing The Cartel Heist. Prepare for the setup, follow the heist plan and complete the finale. The heist is part of the main progression, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Granted when the mission Child's Play is completed. Treat it like any other linear story mission and finish all its objectives. No optional decision influences the unlock.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing the mission Headliners. Play through it to the end and the trophy follows. It is tied to story progression, so there is no limited window to worry about.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unlocked by completing the VCIA Takedown mission. Follow the stealth or combat approach the mission allows and finish it. It is a fixed story mission and stays available until cleared.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Earned for completing Operation Savage Glory. Work through the mission objectives and the trophy triggers on completion. Story missions cannot expire, so take it at your own pace.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Requires reaching full completion of the game, so this is effectively a final checklist trophy. Watch the completion percentage in the pause menu and use it to see what is still outstanding. You will pick it up naturally once every chapter, collectible and activity is done.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 successful stunts anywhere in Leonida. Jumps, flips and close calls all count, so weave them into normal driving instead of grinding one spot. There is no deadline, so it can be chipped away at across the whole save.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Find a good jump or ramp

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the state offers at least once. Open the activities menu early to see the full list, then play one round of each. It is a simple first-time-participation checklist with no missable risk.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the shooting range and take a Gold medal in every challenge listed there. Gold requires hitting target thresholds, so improve your aim and retry individual challenges until they clear. The range stays open, so nothing here expires.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races are scattered around Leonida; win one at each location. Check the map to see which you have cleared and go back to any you lost. Races can be replayed indefinitely, so no attempt is permanently missed.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win twenty distinct races rather than repeating the same event over and over. Rotate through different race types and tracks so each win counts toward the twenty. Races remain available in the world, so this is a steady grind rather than a race against time.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Win with a different race each time

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Head to a fishing spot and beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cast accurately and land the better catch before he does to take the win. Cal reappears, so a lost challenge can be tried again.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and play a game all the way to its end. Any cabinet counts, so choose one with a short loop to save time. The machines stay put, which makes this impossible to miss.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Play a game to the end

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Andy's character strand. Keep progressing his missions as they unlock and clear the finale. Character strands open up through the campaign, so check your map and phone for new markers.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear the concluding mission of Kenton's strand. Work through his earlier missions first, then finish the last one. The strand stays open until completed, so it can be done at your convenience.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Billy's last mission. Follow his mission chain to its conclusion. Nothing is timed, so you can pick it up whenever the strand is available.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight separate stranger strands scattered across Leonida. They show up as unique map markers and phone contacts; complete each strand's last mission to count it. Track them one at a time because they do not expire.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Unlocked by completing Randy's final mission. Advance through his requests until the last one is cleared. The strand remains available, so there is no missable condition.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Earned by finishing Tyrone's last mission. Play through his strand to the end and the trophy follows. It is part of the optional character content and can be revisited freely.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and meditate at each meditation spot in Leonida. Use the map markers or a checklist to make sure you cover every location. The spots remain available after the story, so this is pure exploration.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Open the map to find meditation spots

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks you for. Accept his request, track the animal in the wild and take it using the method he specifies. The side request is repeatable if you fail the first attempt.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Gather the cards needed to finish three complete collectible sets. Cards are found around Leonida and can also be traded or purchased. Fill sets methodically and cross off the ones you complete.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Perform the WAiNK It action at one hundred different locations. Each place counts only once, so spread your visits widely across the map. There is no timer, making it a gradual exploration task.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Clear fifty of the challenges available around Leonida. Challenges cover driving, combat, stamina and more and are listed in the menu. Work through them steadily; they never expire.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Raise a four-star wanted level while your story partner is with you, then evade the police until the heat clears. You need the partner beside you for the whole escape, so try it during a moment when they are available in free roam. Because that pairing is story-bound, putting it off risks losing the chance.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Make sure your partner is with you
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to a specific open-world window with your partner; if you finish the story without trying, that moment is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, rob three shops in a row without letting the wanted level drop between them. Move quickly and keep your partner present for all three. This is a precise combo tied to your partner, so attempt it before the story closes that window.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Keep the wanted level active throughout
trophies.missableWhy: Needs three back-to-back robberies with your partner before the story window closes.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Drive or enter one hundred distinct vehicles so each is logged as discovered. Borrow, steal and rent a wide variety because each new model only counts once. Discovery persists across the save, so there is no missable risk.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Enter a vehicle you have not used

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down five enemies before it ends. Save it for a crowded firefight or line up five targets first. Any combat encounter can be retried, so the attempt is not missable.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, leave in an unscheduled way instead of taking the normal scripted exit. The condition is tied to a particular place and moment, so look for the opening when story reasons bring you there. Passing it up may lock you out, so treat it as missable.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Travel to VCIA during the relevant story beat
trophies.missableWhy: Only available during the VCIA sequence; leaving the normal way can close the opportunity.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This secret trophy fires during a specific encounter involving Rhino tanks. Be ready in the tank section to meet its condition while the scene plays. Because it is bound to a fixed set-piece, skipping the moment can cost you the trophy.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Collect the trophy before it passes
trophies.missableWhy: Bound to a fixed Rhino tank set-piece that passes quickly.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being spotted, with no alarms or witnesses. Scout camera and guard positions, wear a mask and go in quietly. Stores can be robbed again, so a failed attempt is not permanent.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and successfully escape each time. Plan a getaway route and bring enough firepower for the heat. Bank jobs stay available in free roam, so you can work through them at your own pace.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, break it open and get away with the cash. Hit one on a quieter road to keep the initial wanted level low. These trucks respawn, so a failed robbery can be retried.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal and visit every region of Leonida until the map is fully explored. Drive to each named area to clear the fog of war. There is no deadline and exploration persists across the save.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation belonging to every gang in Leonida. Find each gang's site on the map, rob it and get away. There is no limited window, so clear them systematically.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet, specific story moment: have a cocktail with the view at Ocean Beach. The opportunity only arises during the relevant early part of the campaign, so take the drink when the prompt appears. Rushing past the scene can close it off.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Reach the Ocean Beach story moment
Take the cocktail with the view
Enjoy the scene before it ends
trophies.missableWhy: A one-off cocktail moment in the opening story that is easy to walk past.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: During a scripted showroom sequence, smash your way out in the way the trophy asks. The wording points to a fixed set-piece rather than free roam, so follow the scene's prompts closely. Treat it as a chapter-specific, missable moment.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Finish the scene with the trophy
trophies.missableWhy: Bound to a scripted showroom smash-out rather than free roam.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Complete the follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley during the relevant scene. It is a fixed location and a fixed moment, so be ready to perform the action when the scene plays. Missing the window means replaying the chapter.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
trophies.missableWhy: Depends on one specific bowling follow-through scene.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A secret trophy tied to a particular partnership moment between the two leads. The deliberately vague description hides a short, story-locked action, so pay attention during character scenes. Because it is scene-bound, it is effectively missable.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
trophies.missableWhy: A vague, scene-locked partnership moment with no free-roam retry.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Earned through a series of meaningful decisions in the story. The game tracks choices as a running count, so playing through and committing to decisions advances it. Since some decisions are one-time, back up your save before a big choice if you want control over the outcome.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Make story decisions as they appear
trophies.missableWhy: Certain story decisions are one-time and cannot be revisited later.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A secret trophy for succeeding on the second attempt at a specific action. The description hints that you must fail once and then get it right. Watch for the setup during story scenes and deliberately retry rather than rushing on.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
trophies.missableWhy: Requires failing then succeeding at a specific one-shot action.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A secret reaction trophy for witnessing something strange in the world. The vague wording hides a one-off oddity triggered by a particular story beat, so explore and pay attention during unusual scenes. It is tied to a specific moment and is easy to miss.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
trophies.missableWhy: A strange one-off event triggered only during a particular story beat.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee strike from a moving vehicle. Time the hit as you drive past a target. It belongs to a specific setup that passes quickly, so try it while the opportunity is available.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
steps: Strike a target with melee from the car
Collect the trophy before the moment passes
trophies.missableWhy: Needs a melee drive-by at a setup that passes quickly.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contact network until you have made $250,000. Feed the bills through the contacts and collect the returns. It is an ongoing money loop, so there is no missable window.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of one hundred thousand dollars in the shops around Leonida. Buy clothes, vehicles, upgrades and supplies until the spend counter passes the target. Spending is tracked cumulatively, so take your time.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available. Save up cash and purchase each one through the property menu. Purchases are permanent, so this is a simple checklist.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Find eligible vehicles, register them in the app and repeat until ten are logged. The app stays available, so this can be finished whenever you have spare vehicles.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com)
